- The Tender Sum is considered as based on the various Tender Documents being complimentary and interpreted on a collective basis. Unless otherwise is expressly stated in the Contract, no one part of the Contract Document shall have priority over any other part.
- The TenderDocuments cover the following scope:
1. Type 01 - TH01 A (H4 TH A).
2. Type 02 - TH01 B (H4 TH B).
3. Type 03 - TH02 A (SKAIA TH A) TH-23.
4. Type 04 - TH02 B (SKAIA TH B) TH-26.
5. Tender Report that is for guidance only which is not part of the Contract Documents.
6. ID General Finishes which supersede the related ones under the aforementioned items from 1 to 4.
- 7.ID Design Guidelines which supersede the related ones under the aforementioned items from 1 to 4.
- 8.ID General Details which supersede the related ones under the aforementioned items from 1 to 4.
- 9.Architecture General Details which supersede the related ones under the aforementioned items from 1 to 4.
- 10.EMAAR Architecture&StructureSpecs which supersede therelated ones under the aforementioned items from 1 to 4.
- The following items are out of the Contractor's scope as follows:
- oPlantings& SecondaryIrigation Items
- o CCTV
- Active Devices Fiber Optics Cables Electric&WaterMeters

Noting that-for the aforementioned items, the Contractor scope is limited to all required all provisions for their proper installations.
